title: Scaling and Performance Optimization
description: Learn advanced strategies to scale your Node.js applications effectively and optimize their performance. This module covers scaling techniques, load balancing, caching, profiling, and fine-tuning your app to handle real-world traffic smoothly.

lessons.title: Introduction to Scaling in Node.js
lessons.content: Understand the importance of scaling your Node.js applications, different types of scaling (vertical and horizontal), and when to scale based on application needs and traffic.

lessons.title: Load Balancing Techniques
lessons.content: Learn how load balancers distribute incoming traffic across multiple servers to ensure availability and performance. Explore software and hardware load balancers and how to implement them.

lessons.title: Clustering Node.js Processes
lessons.content: Discover Node.js’s cluster module to run multiple instances of your app on different CPU cores to improve performance and reliability.

lessons.title: Horizontal Scaling with Containers and Kubernetes
lessons.content: Learn how to scale applications using container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes for automated deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications.

lessons.title: Caching Strategies for Performance
lessons.content: Explore caching techniques including in-memory caching, HTTP caching, and distributed caches using tools like Redis and Memcached to reduce latency and database load.

lessons.title: Profiling and Monitoring Node.js Applications
lessons.content: Learn how to use profiling tools like Node.js built-in profiler, Clinic.js, and monitoring services like New Relic and Datadog to identify performance bottlenecks.

lessons.title: Optimizing Database Performance
lessons.content: Understand how to optimize database queries, use indexing, connection pooling, and choose between SQL vs NoSQL databases to improve app responsiveness.

lessons.title: Implementing Rate Limiting and Throttling
lessons.content: Learn how to protect your app from traffic spikes and abuse by implementing rate limiting and throttling using middleware like express-rate-limit.

lessons.title: Code Optimization Techniques
lessons.content: Explore best coding practices to improve performance including asynchronous programming, avoiding blocking code, and efficient resource management.

lessons.title: Using CDN and Static Asset Optimization
lessons.content: Learn how to deliver static assets efficiently using Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) and techniques like compression, minification, and cache control.
